claim_boundary.purpose: A fresh falsification check for candidate-specific overfitting, known repaired geometries, public-facade failures, and comparator reversals.
claim_boundary.supported_closeout_claim: When conjoined with the sealed 2,400-image cumulative result, a pass supplies fresh seed-disjoint evidence that the exact public candidate remains at least as scientifically useful as Rapthor's released PyBDSF reference on the explicitly sampled risk cells.

retained_without_reexecution: selected-incumbent Hebog cumulative retention with the disclosed two-pattern confidence limitation
comparator_scope.rationale: Reexecuting every historical comparator would reproduce the oversized campaign. Fresh released-PyBDSF comparison directly answers the initial Rapthor replacement question; the sealed cumulative population already passed both PyBDSF references and Aegean.

binding_checks: every finder run succeeds and publishes a valid finite write-once summary
every one of 36 extended-risk cells passes the existing product-validity and ownership safety rules
every one of six compact guard cells passes the existing product-validity and ownership safety rules
cell-median Hebog movement versus released PyBDSF stays within every predeclared practical margin
no sampled geometry exhibits a material completeness, reliability, flux, position, support, split, duplicate, or topology regression
all 12 caller-owned existing-Dask comparisons are identical to Serial
decision_policy.confidence_interpretation: Four realizations per cell are a deterministic small-sample sentinel, not a powered non-inferiority study. Formal parity and uncertainty claims come from the sealed cumulative evidence.
decision_policy.failure_action: Stop Phase 5 closeout and open a prospective root-cause review. Do not tune, rescore, replace a margin, add samples adaptively, or rerun the one-look result.
decision_policy.one_look_rule: one terminal look with no tuning, rescoring, adaptive sample size, or reconfirmation
decision_policy.trade_off_rule: A small movement is acceptable only inside its already frozen practical margin while released-PyBDSF parity and product-safety gates pass; absolute objectives remain reported long-term targets rather than binding closeout gates.

implementation_requirements: generate and verify the complete manifest without running or viewing an image
prove all 168 seeds remain disjoint from every checked-in development, regression, and qualification manifest
reuse the established analytic Gaussian-noise-v3 generator and reviewed truth compiler rather than introducing a new scientific implementation
bind the exact candidate, released-PyBDSF runtime, manifest, public runner, compiler, evaluator, endpoint rules, immutable checkout, and write-once output
exercise all 168 Hebog cases through the installed top-level public facade under Serial and 12 representative cases through one caller-owned two-worker Dask executor
retain array-free per-image truth, catalogue, support, flux, position, topology, runtime, and provenance summaries
run a complete no-write preflight and confirm at least 8 GiB free before opening the one-use execution
publish one atomic terminal decision and treat any scientific or operational failure as terminal evidence
next_action: Implement the manifest generator, compact guard recipes, runner, compiler, evaluator, and complete no-write preflight test-first; then freeze exact non-executable identities for one final review.

population.extended_risk_design: Seed-disjoint analogue of all 36 reviewed adaptive-background cells: 12 morphology/beam/noise/scale/placement geometries at below, boundary, and above the 75-sigma trigger.

resource_rationale.comparison_with_prior_qualification: The historical 1,688-image, five-run-per-image qualification took about 13.2 hours. This sentinel has one tenth as many images and 348 total executions rather than 8,440.
resource_rationale.safety_action: Do not open execution if the immutable preflight cannot demonstrate completion inside eight hours and within the 8 GiB minimum-free-space envelope.

scientific_question: Does the exact qualified Hebog public candidate remain scientifically no worse than Rapthor's released PyBDSF reference on a small fresh seed-disjoint sample of every known repaired extended geometry plus compact public-contract guards?
